title: Dropping next to a card someone just moved shows a refresh alert
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. A second user with Work Orders view and create and edit (e.g. "Sam Second", Admin role) in a second browser.
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create three Approved work orders led by Esther Howard for the case customer (e.g. "S1-701", "S1-702", "S1-703").
custom_steps:
1. In both browsers open Work Orders, click the All tab, pick Board View and search for the case customer.
  2. In browser 2 drag "S1-702" into Ralph Edwards' column (keep shifts if asked).
  3. In browser 1, without reloading, drag "S1-703" and drop it directly above "S1-702" (still shown in Esther Howard's column there).
  4. Read the alert in browser 1 and where "S1-703" ends up.
  5. Reload browser 1.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Browser 1 shows an alert reading exactly: The card you dropped this next to has moved. Refresh the board and try again.
  • "S1-703" goes back to where it was, and after the reload the board matches browser 2 (S1-702 under Ralph Edwards).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N11, read 8 Oct 2026. PO decision Chris Ward 6 Oct 2026 ("OK as written"). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N11: “A card dropped next to a work order that someone else has just moved is not saved. The alert reads “The card you dropped this next to has moved. Refresh the board and try again.” and the card goes back to where it was.”
